subject: Request: Runway rescue — pilot credit & trial extension
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Kumar <asha@cybella.ai>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Runway rescue — pilot credit & trial extension

Marissa / Aditya —

Cybella is two weeks from a critical internal demo to their execs. Their engineering team hit unexpected throughput limits while exercising the integration, and they’re now blocked on finishing a model evaluation that was supposed to feed the demo. They’ve already burned through the free PLG trial allocation.

Quick context: Cybella is evaluating Redwood for high-throughput, low-latency inference in a regulated vertical. The integration is going well technically, but they need an extra 120k tokens and an additional 21-day sandbox window to complete load tests and the exec demo. Without it, the deal is at real risk — procurement told me they’ll likely move to a competitor if we can’t show the performance numbers by Nov 24.

Ask: Can we approve a one-time, nonstandard extension: +120k free tokens and +21 days sandbox (no changes to contract pricing yet)? I’m requesting Deal Desk authority or executive sign-off for a one-off exception. Attached is the usage report from their sandbox and the draft MOP we plan to share with legal.

Asha — can you confirm the exact kickoff date for the exec demo and whether procurement needs an updated SOW before Nov 24?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: poc-usage-report.csv, mop-draft-v2.pdf
From: Asha Kumar <asha@cybella.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Runway rescue — pilot credit & trial extension

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick note and the usage file. Confirming: our exec demo is scheduled for Nov 24 (internal stakeholders: VP Product, CTO, Head of ML Ops). The testing window needs to include a final 48-hour soak at production-like load; current token exhaustion prevents that. Procurement would prefer a written addendum (simple one-pager) that lists the sandbox extension and token uplift; they said a DocuSign or even a signed email will suffice — they want the timeline and acceptance criteria.

If Redwood can provide the uplift and the extra window, we’ll sign the addendum same day. I’ve attached a short checklist of acceptance criteria to this thread.

—Asha
Principal Product Manager, Cybella AI
asha@cybella.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T11:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Runway rescue — pilot credit & trial extension

Looping in Deal Desk/Finance (Aditya) and Head of Sales Ops (Karthik) because this is a nonstandard exception outside PLG guardrails.

Summary of what Jordan is asking for: one-time +120k tokens and +21 days sandbox; immediate signature on a one-page addendum (DocuSign link suggested by the customer). Customer has agreed to a clear acceptance checklist and to continue procurement conversations in parallel.

Risks/controls to consider:
- Scope: strictly sandbox (no change to billing or long-term discounts).
- Cap the uplift to tokens specified (we can instrument alerting).
- Require a short attestation from the customer that this is for evaluation/demo only.
- Legal should sign off on the one-pager (I’ve attached the MOP draft).

Aditya — can you confirm whether Deal Desk can sign off on a one-off token uplift up to 150k and a 21-day extension? If not, please escalate to the CRO / CEO and advise on the escalation path. We should be explicit about whether credits are refundable or convertible to committed spend.

Jordan — please attach the Cybella acceptance checklist and any procurement contact info (email). I’ll prepare the addendum for legal review so we can have it ready if we get approval.

Marissa
Senior Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: mop-draft-v2.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Runway rescue — pilot credit & trial extension

Thanks for the summary. I approve a limited, documented exception as follows:

- One-time credit: 120,000 free tokens for Cybella AI (to be applied to their sandbox environment only).
- Sandbox extension: +21 calendar days starting on the day we enable the uplift.
- Conditions: customer signs the one-page addendum accepting the uplift and the acceptance criteria; credits expire after the sandbox period; credits are not convertible to invoiced discounts or refunds.
- Instrumentation: Platform/ops to enable token cap and alerting; Jordan to confirm when uplift is enabled and when customer completes final soak.

Marissa — please proceed with the addendum + legal review. Jordan — once addendum is executed, please reply-all with confirmation and set the sandbox start date; Ops (cc’d) will turn on the token allowance.

I’ll note this approval in Deal Desk records (DEAL-9482) and flag for post-mortem: evaluate why trial allocations were insufficient and whether we need updated PLG guardrails.

Aditya Rao
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
